Kashita Maryoku wa [Revo Barai] de Kyousei Choushuu Anime Overview:

Set in a fantasy world driven by magical energy, the story follows Lent, a young adventurer possessing a rare ability to supply mana directly to his teammates. As a member of the rising party known as the Skypiercers, he keeps his comrades continuously fueled for combat. However, after his companions achieve renown and strength largely due to his contributions, they abruptly dismiss him from the group, claiming he is no longer necessary. Left on his own, Lent teams up with a compact and cunning fairy companion who introduces him to an entirely new perspective on his unique skill. Armed with this realization, he sets out on a path to reclaim the magical power he invested in his former allies while navigating the challenges of a competitive adventurer society.

Ranma 1/2 (2024) 3rd Season Anime Overview:

The series follows Ranma Saotome, a teenage martial artist who encounters a cursed training ground during a journey in China. Splashing cold water upon his body transforms him into a young woman, while hot water restores his male form. Returning to Japan, he discovers his father has arranged his engagement to Akane Tendo, the youngest daughter of a fellow martial arts master. Together, the couple navigates a chaotic household alongside a growing cast of eccentric rivals and classmates, all while dealing with their own conflicting feelings and the constant complications brought on by Ranma's unique physical condition.

images.alt:
Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! Anime Overview:

Set at Fujinasu Academy, a private institution known for its high-achieving student body, the story follows first-year student Ume Mizunoe. Although Ume excels in Japanese literature and has earned recognition for his writing, his poor grades in science threaten his academic standing and risk holding him back a year. To salvage his grades and secure his advancement, he accepts an invitation to join the student council. Within this organization, Ume interacts with a distinctive and eccentric cast of peers, including the enigmatic student council president Kotobuki Hisako, the strict yet gentle treasurer Arisu Terui, the playful boy Tan Otori, and the timid administrative staff member Komaro Michinoku. Surrounded by these unpredictable personalities, Ume navigates the daily demands of student council duties while striving to overcome his academic deficiencies in this romantic comedy series.

Japanese Title: 生徒会にも穴はある！

Official Site: https://nama-anaru.com/
